name: Costa Rica
drivers: Unusually hot over the basins (+2.4 SD, 3-month mean)
Root-zone soil drier than normal (-1.3 SD)
Hydro output 13% above normal in the latest Ember month used (2026-09)

costs.method: Estimate only. For each forecast month: P(shortfall) x deficit x blended cost. Deficit = max(0, -anomaly quantile) x normal hydro generation (median of that calendar month's observed output, at the latest capacity). Blended cost assumes 90% of the deficit is replaced at 20 c/kWh and 10% goes unserved at a value of lost load of $1.00/kWh. p10/p50/p90 use the P90/P50/P10 anomaly quantiles. Ignores imports, reservoir re-optimisation and demand response; large exporters (Norway, Canada, Sweden) mostly lose export revenue, not supply.

notes: Ember data ends 2026-10; forecast months start 2026-12.

seasonal_forecast.definition: P(mean capacity-factor anomaly over the 3-month window <= -15%)
